say:1:1330483001:1.text: Just place them somewhere clean. It's cold enough here to keep the ice from melting.
say:1:1330483001:1.source_cn: 只要放在稍微干净些的地方就好，这里够冷，不用担心冰块会化掉。

say:2:1330483002:1.text: Just the other day, Chojack told us the festival urgently needed a large batch of ice. Now that we've finally got it ready, he says there's too much.
say:2:1330483002:1.source_cn: 不过领队前几天说祭典急着要一大批冰，结果等我们加班加点...
